text: {"rules":[{"id":"CRC-SCREEN-50-75","version":"2016","title":"Colorectal cancer screening, adults aged 50 to 75 years","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for colorectal cancer starting at age 50 years and continuing until age 75 years.","grade":"A","effective_date":"2016","action":"Screen for colorectal cancer using one of the listed methods at its stated interval","denominator":"{\"age\":{\"min\":50,\"max\":75,\"at\":\"end\"},\"quote\":\"Adults aged 50 to 75 years\"}","numerator":"{\"any\":[{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"fobt\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Every year\",\"note\":\"gFOBT or FIT, each listed as every year\"},{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"fit_dna\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Every 1 or 3 y\",\"note\":\"Encoded with the 1-year interval only, because footnote d determining 1 vs 3 years is not in the section text\"},{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"colonoscopy\",\"window\":[\"{MY-9}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Every 10 y\"},{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"ct_colonography\",\"window\":[\"{MY-4}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Every 5 y\"},{\"procedure\":{\"concept\":\"flexible_sigmoidoscopy\",\"window\":[\"{MY-4}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"Every 5 y\"}],\"quote\":\"The USPSTF recommends screening for colorectal cancer\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["FIT-DNA frequency is 'Every 1 or 3 y d'. Footnote d is not included in the section text. The rule therefore credits only a FIT-DNA test within the measurement year. A 3-year lookback may be intended and needs human review.","Footnotes b, c, d and e are referenced in the table but their text is not provided, so any conditions they carry are not represented.","The 'Flexible sigmoidoscopy with FIT' strategy (sigmoidoscopy every 10 y plus FIT every year) is not encoded as a separate branch. Any patient meeting it already satisfies the annual stool-test branch, so a separate branch would add nothing. The fobt concept covers both gFOBT and FIT.","The rule has no exclusions, such as colorectal cancer, total colectomy, hospice or death, because none are stated in this section.","The Clinical Considerations section is referenced but not included, so its content is not captured.","Not captured: follow-up of abnormal results and diagnostic colonoscopy after a positive stool test.","Not captured: surveillance intervals and the method-specific considerations in the table (evidence of efficacy, bowel preparation, extracolonic findings, test availability).","The section gives no effective date beyond the document year 2016. effective_date is set to '2016'."]}
